apply_policy.rule: This manifest classifies historical assets only. No docs, reports, knowledge files, or runtime evidence may be moved or deleted until a later apply task validates catalog links, receipt anchors, backlinks, and rollback.
requires_before_apply: Generate an exact file-level move/copy/prune manifest from this collection-level plan.
Run docs catalog regeneration and broken-link checks against every moved path.
Verify closeout receipt, task-report-check, and historical report anchors still resolve.
Apply in a throwaway branch or worktree before touching the main working tree.
Keep copy-first and delete-last rollback commands reviewed before apply.

collections.reason: Task reports are closeout evidence and historical archaeology; moving them without link maps can break receipt/report anchors.
catalog_update_plan: Regenerate compass/docs/catalog.json with old and new paths during transition
Keep compact summaries as first-read entries
link_check_plan: Check markdown links inside task reports
Check receipt/report anchors from closeout runtime summaries
rollback_plan: Keep original compass/docs/task-reports unchanged until every report anchor resolves
Delete redcap-knowledge/task-reports copy if link checks fail

collections.reason: Docs catalog is the progressive-disclosure index that keeps historical docs from being bulk-read; it must remain available while any docs paths move.
catalog_update_plan: Regenerate catalog after any file-level apply
Keep moved-path redirects or aliases until old anchors age out
link_check_plan: Run docs catalog check and budget check after any path changes
rollback_plan: Keep current catalog path authoritative until the moved asset index passes

collections.reason: Local workflow state is ignored runtime data, not a historical asset to migrate into docs or knowledge.
catalog_update_plan: Do not add local runtime state to docs catalog
link_check_plan: Use current-status and runtime checks instead of reading local runtime files as archaeology
rollback_plan: No physical move or delete in P1-2 dry-run

collections.reason: prism/runs is ignored runtime evidence; current lifecycle summary has no purgeable acceptance residue, so physical cleanup is not required now but future prune candidates must pass retention.
catalog_update_plan: Do not add prism/runs contents to docs catalog
link_check_plan: Use prism-runs-lifecycle summary/check instead of bulk-reading run directories
rollback_plan: No physical move or delete in P1-2 dry-run

collections.reason: Research docs are low-frequency human reading material, but current workflow panorama is still linked from status and docs catalog.
catalog_update_plan: Preserve current catalog entries until new knowledge index exists
Add redirect entries before removing old paths
link_check_plan: Check docs catalog entries and README links
rollback_plan: Keep original compass/docs/research unchanged until redirects and catalog entries pass

collections.reason: Specs are already governed by spec-registry and lifecycle policy; moving them belongs to a dedicated spec authority migration.
catalog_update_plan: Keep existing spec registry and docs catalog authoritative
link_check_plan: Use redcap-spec-check for registry and replacement-chain validation
rollback_plan: No physical move in P1-2 dry-run

collections.reason: Trace files are compact but may be referenced by architecture docs and review gates.
catalog_update_plan: Add trace entries to knowledge index before removal from docs
link_check_plan: Check architecture docs for trace references
rollback_plan: Keep original trace file until architecture checks pass

collections.reason: Archive already carries historical material; current action is retention validation, not physical migration.
catalog_update_plan: Keep archive entries discoverable through docs catalog
link_check_plan: Use docs retention check for archive policy
rollback_plan: No physical move in P1-2 dry-run

collections.reason: Knowledge files are active runtime guidance; cold material can move only after index preserves progressive disclosure and hot lessons remain available.
catalog_update_plan: Use compass/knowledge/index.md as the first-read source until external knowledge index is ready
link_check_plan: Check lessons index and revival references before moving cold knowledge
rollback_plan: Keep compass/knowledge authoritative until external knowledge checks pass

global_controls.apply_boundary: P1-2 dry-run is complete when the manifest and checker pass; real movement requires a later apply task.
